summary: Universe Pharmaceuticals INC filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 30, 2026, at its Jiangxi, China headquarters. Shareholders approved re-election of five directors and a conditional 10-for-1 share consolidation triggered if the Nasdaq Class A closing bid stays below $1.00 for three consecutive trading days within 12 months, effected on the 25th trading day after the trigger. Roughly 88.48% of voting shares participated; all resolutions passed with over 99% support. This is a routine meeting notice/outcome, not a special situation; the consolidation is a Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance mechanic.
